changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'reporting' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Global_FieldAudit') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [reporting].[Global_FieldAudit]( [AuditID] [bigint] NOT NULL, [FieldTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [FieldName] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [Value] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [PreviousValue] [nvarchar](max) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ReportingFieldAudit] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [AuditID] ASC, [FieldTypeID] ASC, [FieldName] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[reporting].[Global_FieldAudit]') AND name = 'PreviousValue' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [reporting].[Global_FieldAudit] ADD [PreviousValue] [nvarchar](max) NULL END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ReportingFieldAudit_FieldTypeIDInclude') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ReportingFieldAudit_FieldTypeIDInclude] ON [reporting].[Global_FieldAudit] ([FieldTypeID]) INCLUDE ([Value]) END
ALTER TABLE [reporting].[Global_FieldAudit] DROP CONSTRAINT [PK_ReportingFieldAudit] WITH ( ONLINE = ON ) GO
ALTER TABLE [reporting].[Global_FieldAudit] ADD CONSTRAINT [PK_ReportingFieldAudit] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [AuditID] ASC, [FieldTypeID] ASC, [FieldName] ASC ) GO
if exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'reporting' and TABLE_NAME = 'Global_FieldAudit' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Version') begin alter table reporting.Global_FieldAudit drop column [Version]; end

changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Global_FieldAudit_FieldName_FieldID_WhereClause') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Global_FieldAudit_FieldName_FieldID_WhereClause] ON [reporting].[Global_FieldAudit] ( [AuditID] ASC) INCLUDE (FieldName,FieldTypeID) Where FieldTypeID = 0 END
